title: 第 18 章上品法器的机缘
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
修炼了一个时辰之后陈默感觉自己的状态比之前又好了不少，体内的真元运转顺畅整个人都充满了力量。

    等他走出院落之后站在门口想了想。

    接下来他打算找个安静的地方好好闭关修炼，把金丹五层的修为再往上提升一下。

    可是正当他准备动身的时候眼前忽然弹出了系统的面板，一条新的任务提示出现在他面前。

    【机缘提示：藏经阁二楼的书架之上有一本书籍当中蕴含一道乾坤天机，有缘之人翻阅之后有几率获得一件上品法器的认主。】

    【一炷香之后该机缘会被内门的一位师姐取走，请宿主尽快前往以免错失良机。】

    当陈默看到这条提示之后眉头微微皱了一下，因此在心里想着藏经阁二楼那不是内门弟子才能去的地方？

    自己一个外门弟子怎么上去，那个守阁的老者肯定不会让他进的。

    不过话又说回来上品法器这可是好东西，现在他虽然有了上品法术和上品丹药的丹方但法器方面还什么都没有。

    要是能拿到一件上品法器，他的实力又能往上提升不少。

    想到这里的陈默收回思绪然后快步朝着藏经阁的方向走去，不管怎么样先去看看再说。

    穿过几条走廊之后没过多久陈默就来到了藏经阁的门口。

    当他推门走进去就看到那个守阁的老者坐在角落里的椅子上，只见他闭着眼睛像是在打盹。

    等陈默走进去之后老者的眼睛就睁开了，只见他看着陈默而且脸上还露出了一丝笑意。

    “年轻人又来了。”老者开口道。

    “前辈。”陈默拱了拱手算是打了个招呼。

    那老者看着陈默的眼神里带着几分欣赏，这个年轻人不简单毕竟上次拿破境丹来换剑谱就已经让他刮目相看了。

    “你今天来藏经阁是想找功法还是想找什么法术。”

    “晚辈想上二楼看看。”陈默说道。

    当老者听到这话之后眉头立刻皱了起来，他摇了摇头脸上的表情也变得严肃起来。

    “不行，藏经阁二楼只有内门弟子才能进，这是宗门的规矩老夫不能坏了规矩。”

    “前辈通融一下。”陈默说道。

    “通融不了，你是外门弟子就不能上二楼，这是规矩谁来了都一样。”

    当陈默看着老者坚定的表情知道说再多也没有用，他在心里想着看来得换个法子才行。
content_en:
After practicing for an hour, Chen Mo felt that his condition was much better than before. The true energy in his body was running smoothly and his whole body was full of strength.

    After he walked out of the courtyard, he stood at the door and thought for a while.

    Next, he planned to find a quiet place to practice in seclusion and improve his cultivation to the fifth level of the Golden Core.

    But just as he was about to leave, the system panel suddenly popped up in front of him, and a new task prompt appeared in front of him.

    [Opportunity reminder: There is a book on the bookshelf on the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion that contains a secret of heaven and earth. After reading it, those who are destined to read it have a chance of getting the owner of a high-grade magic weapon. 】

    [After one stick of incense, the opportunity will be taken away by a senior sister from the inner sect. Please go to the host as soon as possible to avoid missing the opportunity. 】

    When Chen Mo saw this prompt, he frowned slightly, so he thought to himself that the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion was not a place only inner disciples could go.

    How could an outer disciple of his go up? The old man guarding the pavilion would definitely not let him in.

    But then again, a high-grade magic weapon is a good thing. Now, although he has high-grade spells and high-grade elixirs, he still has nothing in terms of magic weapons.

    If he could get a high-grade magic weapon, his strength would be greatly improved.

    Thinking of this, Chen Mo retracted his thoughts and walked quickly towards the Sutra Pavilion. No matter what, he went to take a look first.

    After walking through several corridors, it didn't take long for Chen Mo to arrive at the door of the Sutra Pavilion.

    When he opened the door and walked in, he saw the old man guarding the pavilion sitting on a chair in the corner. He had his eyes closed and seemed to be taking a nap.

    The old man's eyes opened when Chen Mo walked in, and he was seen looking at Chen Mo with a smile on his face.

    "The young man is here again." The old man said.

    "Senior." Chen Mo cupped his hands as a greeting.

    The old man looked at Chen Mo with some admiration in his eyes. This young man was not simple. After all, he had been impressed by the last time he exchanged the Breaking Realm Pill for the sword manual.

    "Did you come to the Sutra Pavilion today to find some exercises or spells?"

    "Junior wants to go up to the second floor and have a look." Chen Mo said.

    When the old man heard this, he immediately frowned, shook his head and his expression became serious.

    "No, only inner disciples can enter the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion. This is the sect's rule. I cannot break the rule."

    "Senior, please be accommodating." Chen Mo said.

    "I can't accommodate you. If you are an outer disciple, you can't go to the second floor. This is a rule that applies to everyone."

    When Chen Mo looked at the old man's firm expression and knew that it was useless no matter how much he said, he thought to himself that he had to find another way.
title_en: Chapter 18 The opportunity of high-grade magic weapon
